images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2x2 sprite atlas of four separate cosmic nebula cloud wisps for a fantasy boss arena. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: match its exquisite detailed luminous blue/violet nebula filaments and dense dimensional billowing cloud interiors. Make four DIFFERENT long wisps, one entirely contained in each equal quadrant of a square 1024x1024 atlas. Each wisp is horizontal, roughly 3:1 width to height, and fully surrounded by at least 35 pixels of EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding within its own 512x512 quadrant; no piece touches another or the image edges. Top-left: cobalt/cyan cloud ribbon with a bright curling rim and a dark indigo interior. Top-right: violet billowing ribbon with delicate lavender filaments. Bottom-left: thin slate-blue smoke tendril with airy holes and curled ends. Bottom-right: violet/magenta storm cloud with a broken luminous edge. Irregular organic cloud silhouettes, partially transparent fine feathered wisps around dense dark opaque cloud interiors. Intended to drift across the existing space backdrop and briefly hide stars/ruins, so there must be NO background star field, NO background rectangle, no large isolated glowing stars. Actual transparent background. No ground, no architecture, no characters, no writing, no grids or dividing lines. Rich rendered detail, not smooth Gaussian blobs. Preserve dark interiors rather than making every pixel luminous.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2x2 sprite atlas containing FOUR separate broken celestial arch segments for a fantasy cosmic boss arena. The supplied image is the material/style reference: massive ruined ancient bronze and dark stone, with weathered pitted faces and small ivory-gold cracks. Make ONE isolated piece in each of four equal quadrants of a square atlas, ALL pieces entirely inside their own quadrant with generous empty transparent padding on EVERY side (at least 15% of each cell). Top-left: a thick jagged crescent-shaped arch segment, quarter of a circle, seen from slightly above. Top-right: a broad shallow curved broken band with shattered ends and carved recesses. Bottom-left: a taller narrow curved buttress fragment. Bottom-right: a small irregular architectural block. These are disconnected ruined fragments, NOT a whole ring, no intersecting pieces. Strong dark three-dimensional stone sides, restrained thin gold highlights, NO brilliant solid gold band, no large bloom. Cold violet reflected light on the dark sides to match a deep-blue/magenta space background. Each piece has an irregular crumbling outline and visibly thick dimensional edges. Keep them weathered and monumental, not smooth jewelry. Background actually transparent. Absolutely no cloud, sky, starfield, floor, characters, labels, grid or dividing lines. NO piece touches any image edge or crosses the horizontal or vertical center line.
